experiment: CBF-2 linear ceiling and basis-support audit
solver: FP64 economy SVD, cutoff eps(float64)*max(matrix.shape)*largest singular value; minimum-norm OLS. No bias or centering. Solve all five existing oracle outputs for CBF-1 score parity; first four columns equal H+Y for the requested four numeric attributes.
candidate_examples: Deduplicate candidate texts within original train; assert each has equal multiplicity in original flattened CBF-1 training pairs and consistent targets. Never fit on original evaluation rows.

ridge.selection: Lowest mean squared error on the four numeric outputs on an inner validation set only; exact ties select larger lambda
ridge.inner_split: Original train scenarios grouped by family and K; sorted scenario IDs, seed-7 permutation, two of eight scenarios per group validate; remaining six train. Final selected lambda refits all original train candidates.

attribute_reports: train and each original evaluation split
criterion_supported: Only the 20 original training criterion IDs (slots 0/1), all their four already-cached wordings. Never include slots 2/3 or held families in criterion fitting or wording-ceiling estimates.
centroid: Normalize the centroid of each ID's two original training wording embeddings; nearest cosine centroid for the 40 unseen wording strings. Report semantic ID accuracy, exact oracle direction accuracy, and oracle-candidate decision accuracy.
criterion_original_OLS: Also fit exactly the 40 original training wording strings and score their 40 original unseen wordings for a same-data solver comparison against CBF-1 SGD. Three-wording leave-out folds alter wording coverage and cannot alone isolate optimizer effects.
criterion_OLS: Four folds: hold the same wording-template index for every supported semantic criterion, train on the other three cached wordings per criterion, test the held wording. Each fold has 60 unique train strings and 20 unique test strings; semantic IDs shared deliberately, exact test strings excluded. OLS maps into existing five-coordinate oracle basis; unsupported outputs remain zero. Report equal-fold macro and micro metrics; per-query cosine, vector MSE, nonzero target-coordinate sign accuracy, ternary sign accuracy on supported coordinates {0,1,constant} with zero tolerance 1e-8, oracle-candidate top1, family/K bins, and all fold IDs.
causal: Reaggregate persisted CBF-1 swaps and predictions. Text/oracle evaluated on all existing swaps; oracle/text supported subset requires both criteria inside the training target span. Report other arms as controls on those same subsets, split/family/K counts, CRA, conditional response, changed-to-new-teacher, both endpoints correct, and teacher-stable unwanted changes. No refitting.

gates.candidate_linear_ceiling_high: OLS train top1 >=0.95 and all four slot R2 >=0.95
gates.candidate_supported_transfer: Selected ridge oracle-criterion top1 >=0.95 on original unseen-wording rows and supported-direction held-family rows
gates.criterion_OLS_high: Equal-fold oracle-candidate top1 >=0.95 and mean direction cosine >=0.99
gates.run_resplit: All four gates pass; otherwise record CBF-2D as gated off, no neural retraining

support_complete_resplit: Use only existing rows. Keep original held families entirely out of train. For every known-family/source-split/K stratum, seed-7 shuffle sorted existing scenario IDs and reserve one quarter (at least one) for evaluation. Train only original rows with wording indices 0/1 on non-reserved scenarios, excluding the existing negative slot-3 direction (all minimizing criteria at attribute slot 3). Evaluate reserved scenarios: supported trained-ID wordings 2/3 as unseen wording; negative slot-3 rows as unseen direction; all original held-family rows as held family. Drop all other rows, never synthesize questions or candidates. Verify train target span rank5, every held target in that span, disjoint candidate scenarios/strings, and semantic-ID disjointness for unseen directions. Corpus contains no genuine mixed-coordinate criteria, so no combination claim is possible.
conditional_full_CBF: Only if supported gates pass: original CBF-32 architecture, seed7, AdamW 0.001/0.0001, batch128, 200 epochs. Compare frozen cosine on unseen direction and held family using same criterion-group paired 95% CI; require both lower bounds >0 and positive held-family deltas in at least two families with positive aggregate. Verify exact candidate permutation scores. Only this pass can unblock B-STEF; never launch B-STEF here.
decision_scope: OLS training residual is the finite-sample bias-free linear least-squares ceiling, not proof no nonlinear readout could recover attributes and not a theorem about all embeddings. Low training R2 with moderate top1 blocks this frozen linear candidate interface. High retrieval but poor OLS implicates this continuous mapping, not missing semantic information. Shared-criterion leave-wording-out is paraphrase evaluation, not novel-criterion generalization.
